newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WILLIAMSON TAKES CONTROL AT KILMARNOCK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WILLIAMSON TAKES CONTROL AT KILMARNOCK.

text.p: Scottish premier league club Kilmarnock appointed reserve team coach Bobby Williamson as their new manager on Monday until the end of the season.
Williamson stepped in as caretaker four matches ago after new Kilmarnock chairman Ronnie Hamilton sacked Alex Totten on December 3.
The Ayrshire club confirmed that Williamson has been charged with the task of keeping second-from-bottom Kilmarnock in the premier division.
